sourceRefs.description: Recovered native controls, 388 Twin files equal February 2019 backup; refer to h2o-controls-reference.json
Illustrative terminal assignments except verified Twin line links; 5MW units, 0.6kV SS, 120kV nominal, dynamic and electrical settings are training assumptions.

assumptions.topology: Source-linked illustrative complex; not a verified as-built netlist
assumptions.voltageLabels: Source has 115/120 and 230/240 labels; this model uses 120 and 230 kV nominal.
assumptions.water: Separate 100000 m2 ponds, constant tailwater, no calibrated river routing.

limitations: Source-inspired training network, not a validated as-built plant model.
Linearized P-angle / Q-voltage flow with reduced-order governor, excitation and frequency dynamics; no relay/transient certification.
Ratings, secondary voltages, loads, limits, delays and untraced terminals are explicit illustrative assumptions.
